meta.notes: v2 — 'The Instrument Line' (supersedes v1 'Masthead & the Mark'). Drop-in remap for existing alfa-ds roles. Registers: 'product' (dark) and 'brand' (light). Inherited hard rules kept: surface-stepped elevation, no shadows, no card borders, pill buttons. v2 hard rules: ONE signal color (Flare, international orange) — the node/step/action only, rationed at ~2% of any surface; brand-text variant for small type contrast; yellow and the v1 accent blue are retired; market up/down are data-only; the step motif appears only where an event actually occurred.

font-display.usage: Brand/marketing display only — one weight plus italic; emphasis via italic and the line, never bolding.

font-mono.usage: The tape layer: timestamps, tickers, figures, filings. tabular-nums wherever digits meet.

motion.spec: Material items: underline/line draws left-to-right 550ms then node pops 200ms at the corner — once per event, never looping in product. Numbers tick like tape. Quiet surfaces do not move. Ambient instrument line allowed on brand surfaces only. prefers-reduced-motion renders final states.
